Walkthrough

The changes add badge update management and utilities for selecting existing app windows, matching installed apps to URLs, and grouping tabs by app, preset, active domain, or hostname. **Changes: Badge updates** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Badge state and updates**
`background/badge.js`|The module adds busy-state control and action-popup selection. It reads the configured window scope to count matching tabs, updates the badge, and schedules delayed updates. | **Window matching and tab grouping** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Window and app matching**
`utils/window-matcher.js`|The module selects an exact-URL or same-domain app or popup window. It also matches eligible installed apps to valid HTTP(S) URLs. | |**Tab grouping**
`utils/window-matcher.js`|The module groups valid tabs by installed app, preset, active domain, or hostname. It fills missing icons from tab favicons and sorts groups by tab count. | **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Change:** Other
Merge Risk: Low · up to 9b4b5

The new window-matching and badge helpers have several small correctness gaps: case-distinct URLs can be treated as duplicates, apps can be matched by name despite explicit domains, some installed apps are not grouped, and the badge count can briefly be stale. None is severe or hard to recover from, but they are worth fixing if this code is ever adopted. The PR is marked as an experiment and not for merge.

issue.body:
Adds `auto_review.base_branches: ["review/.*"]` to the central config.

Why: review-only PRs (`bin/cr-full-review`, and the planned coderabbit-steward) sit on `review/*/base` branches. CodeRabbit doesn't auto-review non-default bases, so today they need an `@coderabbitai review` comment after opening. With this setting the `cr-review` label is enough, which removes a step and a 10-minute wait from every full review.

Tested on kleinbem/chrome-open-in-app#15 with the same setting in the PR branch's config (`inheritance: true`): a labelled draft PR on a `review/…/base` branch was picked up 15 seconds after it opened and reviewed in 6 min 40 s, at the usual cost of one review.

Effect elsewhere: none. Only PRs whose base matches `review/.*` are affected, and they still need the label. `bin/cr-full-review` keeps posting its comment; removing that is a follow-up.

Draft: held until Martin says go.
